description: This file defines functions and interfaces for generating terminal commands within a VSCode extension, including user prompts, terminal context building, and API configuration handling.

classes.name: TerminalCommandGeneratorOptions
classes.description: Interface defining options for terminal command generation, including output channel and extension context.

methods.name: generateTerminalCommand
methods.description: Main function to generate a terminal command based on user input and context, handling warnings and errors.

methods.name: showWarningIfNeeded
methods.description: Displays a warning dialog if not acknowledged previously, and updates global state upon acknowledgment.

methods.name: getUserInput
methods.description: Prompts the user for input via an input box.

methods.name: executeCommandGeneration
methods.description: Executes the process of generating and sending a command to the active terminal, showing progress and confirmation.

methods.name: buildTerminalContext
methods.description: Builds context information about the terminal environment, including OS, directory, shell, and history.

methods.name: getTerminalHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the last 200 lines of terminal output for context.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors by logging and showing error messages to the user.

methods.name: getApiConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the API configuration profile, possibly loading a specific profile based on stored IDs.
